title: Subsequence evaluation respects derived transitions
statement:
For a≤b and a strictly increasing subsequence r, the selected derived evaluation comparison at b followed by the original transition from r(b) to r(a) equals the subsequence transition from b to a followed by restriction of the selected evaluation comparison at a.

Precise formal conclusion with its module-variable context (notation is that of the cited statement dependencies):
```lean
universe u v w
variable {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
  [J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})]
  [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}] [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
  (B : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Sheaf J CommRingCat.{w})
theorem systemDerivedSubsequenceTransition (r : ℕ ↪o ℕ) {a b : ℕ} (h : a ≤ b)
    (M : DerivedCategory (StrictRingSystem B)) :
    (systemDerivedSubsequenceEvaluation B r b).hom.app M ≫
        (systemDerivedTransition B (r.monotone h)).app M =
      (systemDerivedTransition (selectedSystemRings B r) h).app
          ((derivedSystemSubsequence B r).obj M) ≫
        (systemRestriction B (r.monotone h)).mapDerivedCategory.map
          ((systemDerivedSubsequenceEvaluation B r a).hom.app M)
```
